findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: The three stale surfaces may have been intended as a pre-008 release snapshot, but package version 2.13.0.0 is still current and these are the only feature/changelog surfaces a reader reaches for the current command.
findingDetails.case: An operator applies a map whose moved packet fails its own strict validation; the run lands and exits 3, while the feature page says exit 2 means a failed close.
findingDetails.claim: The feature page and changelog document a 0/1/2 exit contract that omits phase-008 status 3, so a landed move whose only failure is the moved packet validation is described as a failed close.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Checked the command README, changelog upgrade notes and phase 008 goal for an alternate status meaning; the command README is current and the phase goal confirms status 3.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: If the feature page and changelog are declared historical snapshots and a current release page carries the 0/1/2/3 contract, downgrade to P2.
findingDetails.scopeProof: The same omission appears in feature-catalog/feature-catalog.md:690 and changelog/v2.13.0.0.md:67; runtime/cli/spec/README.md:120 is current. rg over the three stale surfaces returns all three, so a single current reference exists and the three summaries are the class of gap.
findingDetails.title: Relocation feature page and changelog still state the pre-008 exit contract and omit status 3

findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: The quick-reference command may be a simplified live-only example, but it is labeled Next spec number and is the only command offered.
findingDetails.case: A root has live 001-a and archived z_archive/007-b; the SKILL command prints 001 and a person choosing 002 collides with the archived range that create.sh would skip.
findingDetails.claim: The SKILL quick reference computes the next number from live root packets only, and the phase-definition guide describes the same live-only rule, contrary to D4 and create.sh.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Searched the remaining changed docs for a caveat that the command is live-only or that archives are intentionally excluded; no caveat exists.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: If the table is annotated as live-only and points to create.sh as the authoritative counting surface, downgrade to P2.
findingDetails.scopeProof: rg for "Next spec number" and "next number after the highest numbered packet" returns SKILL.md:295 and phase-definitions.md:82; create.sh:1644 is the only producer that implements both live and archived counting.
findingDetails.title: Published next-number command ignores archived packets

findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: The READMEs may intentionally leave exit statuses to the command README.
findingDetails.case: A reader starts from the skill README and sees only dry-run/apply wording, missing that a landed run can exit 3.
findingDetails.claim: The two top-level README summaries omit status 3, so a first-read operator has no cue that a landed run can exit 3 with a packet-validation warning.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: The READMEs are summaries, not full command contracts; the omission is not a contradiction, which is why the severity is P2.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: No further downgrade below P2; close as advisory if the summaries add a link to the command README contract.
